question: How did the share of households whose most educated member had lower-secondary education or less change between 2010 and 2020?
expected_answer: It fell from half of all households in 2010 to about 44 percent in 2020.

gold.evidence:
In 2010, in half of all households, the
maximum level of education of any member was lower-
secondary level or less (Figure 2.3). By 2020, this share fell
to about 44 percent of all households.
